name: Katherine Wiese (secretly Ecaterina, former Sabbat Bishop)

system.concept: Camarilla ancilla; secretly a centuries-old Brujah, former Sabbat bishop of New York

morality.path: Path of Power and the Inner Voice

system.biography:
Background

Eight centuries ago, a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} anarch named Ecaterina fled the Old World for New York, rose to become a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} bishop of the city, and grew disillusioned enough with the sect's degeneration to publicly denounce it at the Palla Grande — only to be struck down moments later by an @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} antitribu assassination team. She awoke nearly thirty years later in a disused subway electrical room, rescued by an unknown benefactor (in truth the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} Yvette, who does not know Ecaterina's true identity), with no memory of who saved her and no way to know whether Archbishop Polonia himself ordered her death. Reinventing herself as Katherine Wiese, a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} ancilla of convenient luck, she now plays a careful, mercenary game in the reclaimed city's politics — determined to discover who she owes her survival to, resolve her suspicions about Polonia, and never again gamble her safety on any sect's cause.

Roleplaying Hints

Unlife is for surviving, not for grand causes. You weigh every situation for advantage and align with whoever is winning, though old pangs of guilt for abandoning the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah}'s idealism still occasionally surface as rage or despair.
system.notes: Sire: Marhuel. True identity: Ecaterina, a former @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} bishop of New York believed destroyed in an @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} antitribu assassination attempt at the Palla Grande. Presence 6 in the book is capped to 5 for LARP play; other ratings above 5 have likewise been capped.

vtmlarp.source: New York by Night, 2nd Edition, Chapter Three: All the Beautiful Monsters
